subject: Vendor Enablement Kickoff — MAP & PO Alignment
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor Enablement Kickoff — MAP & PO Alignment

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your inference deployment. We'd like to schedule an initial vendor enablement kickoff to align on the mutual action plan (MAP), PO process, intake forms, and success criteria so procurement and engineering move in lockstep.

Proposed 45–60m slots (PT):
- Tue, Sep 5 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed, Sep 6 — 10:00–11:00 (preferred)
- Thu, Sep 7 — 14:00–15:00

Draft agenda (please suggest edits):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) MAP review — milestones & owners (10m)
3) PO process & PO template review (10m)
4) Onboarding forms & evidence collection (SOC2, network, billing) (10m)
5) Timeline, success criteria, blockers, next steps (10–15m)

Pre-reads attached: ALTURA_MAP_DRAFT.xlsx and PO_Template_v3.pdf. Also linking a short vendor intake form (I'll attach the zip of forms in the follow-up).

Please confirm: 1) which slot works, 2) attendee names + titles (we need procurement and technical contact), and 3) any must-have agenda items. Our goal: signed PO within 30 days of kickoff and a technical smoke test on your first integration by day 14.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Ben Carter
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: ALTURA_MAP_DRAFT.xlsx, PO_Template_v3.pdf

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Sara. Wed 2028-09-06 10:00 PT is booked on my side; I'll send the calendar invite with a Zoom link and the MAP attached.

Quick clarifications and asks prior to the call:
- Michael/Tariq (procurement) — can you confirm if Altura requires a PO number format or EDI fields? If you send a sample PO we can validate the fields against our billing/finance flow.
- Priya — if you can share the intended integration owner(s) and an internal Slack channel, we'll add them to the invite.
- For our internal coordination I have looped in Laura Bennett (onboarding lead) and Neha Kapoor (legal/compliance).

I attached vendor_onboarding_forms.zip (vendor intake form, SOC2 checklist stub, network/firewall questionnaire). Please try to complete the vendor intake form before the call — it will cut follow-up cycles in half.

Success criteria we will track:
- Signed PO executed within 30 days of kickoff
- Completed vendor intake & evidence within 10 business days
- Test deployment (smoke) within 14 calendar days of integration start

See you on Wed. I will send the invite within the hour.

Ben

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_forms.zip

- Ben: owner for meeting and MAP walk-through (you)
- Marissa: lead on onboarding steps and PO operations (please prepare our PO checklist and any finance contacts)
